simplifications.proposal: Implement full chatbot UI with streaming message bubbles as the default
simplifications.rationale: Chatbots are clumsy for specifying dates, durations, and multi-select categories. A clean structured constraints form provides 10x faster trip configuration.

simplifications.proposal: Run local on-device small language model (e.g. MediaPipe LLM Inference)
simplifications.rationale: Excessive app binary size (+2GB), high memory usage, and risk of hallucinations. Server-side grounded endpoint ensures canonical fact boundaries.

simplifications.proposal: Build a complex drag-and-drop itinerary node graph editor
simplifications.rationale: Recomputing valid itineraries deterministically from updated constraints is vastly simpler and avoids invalid routing state bugs.

simplifications.proposal: Create a new duplicate Place domain model for itinerary stops
simplifications.rationale: Reusing canonical placeId and existing M8/M10 presentation components preserves single source of truth.

simplifications.proposal: Introduce Room SQLite / SwiftData tables to persist drafts
simplifications.rationale: Wave M13 is generation and presentation only. Persistence is explicitly M14 scope.
